title: Layer 3 round 2 major, three-lens convergent (SE+security+UX): #777 incomplete — the human form's composition line, the broken-state human form, and main.rs diagnostic prints interpolate state-sourced text raw; live ESC/BEL/newline injection through ordinary vsdd status

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in ff0d3a3f: clean_for_terminal (now pub for the binary crate) reaches every human-form interpolation the round-1 pass missed — the composition line's scope and each domain, the broken-state human form's diagnostic message and kind, and cmd_status's three registry/config diagnostic prints. The hostile-state test seeds a hostile scope and domain; a new broken_state_human_form test seeds a diagnostic whose message and kind carry ESC/BEL/forged-newline and asserts none reach the surface and the message renders one line. Segment and machine forms were already safe (the machine form is serde JSON — escaped by construction). Three-lens convergence honored: SE and UX found the composition line, security the broken form and main.rs prints, all one class.
